name: music-compile-generation-prompt
description: Platform-ready generation payload from annotated lyrics + piano-roll spec — validates platform, bpm, key, tags, lyrics section markers, and prompt quality for Sonauto/MusicGen/AudioLDM2/StableAudio

input.strings:
Platform: sonauto

Annotated lyrics summary: Whisperheads by Horus. BPM: 85, Key: D minor, Time Signature: 4/4. Genre: indie, alternative, atmospheric, dark. Emotional arc: verse (fear→sadness, whisper/sing, p/mp) → chorus (trust→anger, belt, f). 4 phrases across 8 bars.

Piano-roll spec summary: 8 bars total. Verse (bars 1-4): Dm-Am-Bb-Gm, energy 0.2-0.35. Chorus (bars 5-8): Bb-F-Gm-Dm, energy 0.6-0.8. Instruments: bass, keys, vocal; drums enter at chorus. Notes include whispered vocal at D3/A2 range building to belted D4 at chorus.

Song brief: Dark atmospheric indie/alternative. Influences: Radiohead Kid A textures, Portishead trip-hop darkness, Nine Inch Nails The Fragile quiet-loud dynamics. Target sound: sparse keys, deep bass, atmospheric pads, lo-fi crackle in verse, clean/wide in chorus. BPM 85, slow and deliberate.

Lyrics:
[verse]
They speak in static frequencies
Beneath the hum of broken light

[chorus]
We are the whisperheads
Tuned to the noise you left behind

cases.notes: Validates sonauto payload against Whisperheads compilation ground truth. Platform must be sonauto, bpm/key must match exactly, tags must include core genre/mood words, lyrics must contain section markers.

input.strings:
Platform: musicgen

Annotated lyrics summary: Whisperheads by Horus. BPM: 85, Key: D minor, Genre: indie, alternative, atmospheric, dark. Emotional arc: fear/sadness verse → trust/anger chorus.

Piano-roll spec summary: 8 bars total. Verse sparse and lo-fi. Chorus wide and full. Instruments: bass, keys, vocal, drums (chorus only).

Song brief: Dark atmospheric indie/alternative. Influences: Radiohead Kid A, Portishead trip-hop, Nine Inch Nails The Fragile. Sparse keys, deep bass, atmospheric pads, lo-fi crackle verse, clean chorus.

cases.notes: MusicGen does not support lyrics — instrumental must be true and lyrics field omitted. Prompt should be a single dense descriptive sentence.
